prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, late 30s goddess, curved bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sculpted updo ash brown hair — her body is covered in 4 different shiny materials at once, each material claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 60% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 12 o'clock, 2 o'clock, 5 o'clock and 9 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 2 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied rose-gold leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright rose-gold sheen. Region 2 is the wedge between the 2 o'clock ray and the 5 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries mirror chrome paint, a seamless liquid-mirror coat reflecting the light in sharp bright highlights. Region 3 is the wedge between the 5 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries cobalt-blue high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 4 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied silver leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright cool silver sheen. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring materials blend along the edge: the edge of one reaches into the other and the two simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every material laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, her legs fully in view — most extreme curved bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy silver crystal-flecked leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in silver crystal-flecked lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
